labels.name: documentation
labels.rationale: Reports a broken link in the root docs and asks how to contribute the fix; the docs row applies even when the issue also asks about contributing.

items.body:
Thanks for the report. Rich does not accept pull requests from external contributors; see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md). Describing the change in an issue first is the route, and this issue already does that. Please name the file and the broken link here so a maintainer can apply the fix. Any PR would also need to follow [AI_POLICY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/AI_POLICY.md). Related: #4029 (closed, same topic).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
